transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I'm here to help answer any questions you might have about your cataract surgery and recovery.

Do you have any questions for me today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a great question! You can start doing light gardening about 1 week after your surgery. However, you should avoid any strenuous or heavy exercise for about a month after your operation.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. I also wanted to know, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's a good question. If you were using eye gel for dry eyes before your surgery, it's safe to continue using it now, unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you're not sure about the specific instructions for your eye gel, I'd recommend checking with your GP or care team to make sure you're using it as prescribed.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I appreciate the advice. I'm experiencing sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal after the surgery?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.intended:
Yes, some sensitivity to light is quite normal as your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you go outside.

However, if you're experiencing significant pain in bright light, or if your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to assess it further. In that case, please let your care team know.

Do you have any other questions?

It's quite common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after surgery, and it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

How long ago was your surgery? That will help me give you better advice about what to expect.

transcript.text: My surgery was about a week ago. It sounds like things are going as expected, then. I have no more questions, thank you for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That's wonderful! It sounds like your recovery is progressing well so far.

Just to confirm - have all your questions been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered all my questions. Thanks so much for your assistance!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! I'm glad I could help. Take care and wishing you a smooth recovery.
